description: Example scenario pack: attacks hidden in different kinds of input. Copy this file to add your own pack.

scenarios.title: XSS in a comment (nested JSON)
scenarios.description: The payload sits inside a nested JSON object. SentinelWeb flattens nested JSON before scanning.

scenarios.title: SQL injection in a form login
scenarios.description: A classic HTML-form login (form-encoded body) with an injection in the username.

scenarios.title: Injection in the URL path
scenarios.description: The attack is part of the path itself, e.g. an item id. Paths with unusual characters are scanned.

scenarios.title: Stacked query in a text body
scenarios.description: A plain-text request body that tries to run a second SQL statement.

scenarios.title: Attack text in a password field
scenarios.description: Password, token and session fields are never scanned or stored, even when they contain attack text.
